scripts.name: 7mint
scripts.description: imagine D3C but if it was a bad chinese clone. 7mint is a Garry's mod cheat (x64), that utilizes lj-expand as it's loader.

scripts.name: antifreeze
scripts.description: a swiss army knife multi-tool script for LJE (a tool for garry's mod allowing you to run clientside lua with basically no detection)

scripts.name: ffi-lens
scripts.description: ffi-lens is a FFI tool focused on GMod reverse engineering. It provides a neat, simple ImGUI interface to explore and interact with the game's memory, modules, and more. It's designed to be user-friendly and efficient, making it easier for developers to locate certain functions and data within the game's memory.

scripts.name: gilbhax
scripts.description: Rewrite of gilbhax for LJE 2, the new isolated state model.

scripts.name: lje-util
scripts.description: A utility library made for LJ-Expand which re-adds a lot of functions implemented purely in GLua, as well as new functions which would be useful, and provides security features which would otherwise need to be manually created.

scripts.name: tts
scripts.description: Fully local text-to-speech piped into GMod's voice chat, entirely in-process using LJE & LJE-FFI.
